name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei Zhao's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly during his university days. While pursuing his accounting degree, he volunteered at the Singapore Grand Prix, initially handling ticketing logistics. The roar of the engines and the precision of the teams ignited a passion that led him to intern with a local racing team, managing their finances. After graduating, he honed his skills in corporate finance before returning to motorsport, driven by a desire to combine his financial expertise with his love for racing. 

At Trident, Wei brings a meticulous and forward-thinking approach to financial management. He believes in leveraging data-driven insights to optimize team spending and identify opportunities for investment in technology and talent. He's known for his ability to spot potential risks and develop proactive mitigation strategies, ensuring the team's financial stability and competitive edge. Wei's knack for finding hidden efficiencies and his relentless pursuit of financial excellence make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.
